schema_note: One window only, the plan's own. trip-windows/1 (overview spec 2.2) needs 2 to 4 windows, so this file keeps the same field names under trip-season-basic/1 and adds a `season` block in the adapter's Season shape.
months_basis_note: The plan's own months: the plan runs over the turn of September into October, so both months are listed.

sources.title: Canadian Climate Normals 1991-2020, QUEBEC/JEAN LESAGE INTL A (7016294)

points.name: Québec Jean Lesage airport climate station
points.note: Station coordinates as printed on the ECCC normals page; the station is at the airport, west of the old city.

label.value: Last days of September into early October

why.value: The plan's own short break at the turn of the month; normals give cool days, cold nights and rain on about one day in three.

tempC.value: 8 to 19 C in September, 2 to 11 C in October (mean daily low to high)
tempC.note: 1991-2020 normals, Québec airport: Sep max 19.1, min 8.3; Oct max 11.3, min 2.4.

rain.value: About 10 days with 1 mm or more in September and 11 to 12 in October; about 110 to 115 mm a month
rain.note: Sep 111.3 mm, 9.8 days >= 1 mm; Oct 115.8 mm, 11.5 days >= 1 mm.

daylight.value: Sunrise about 06:40, sunset about 18:30; just under 12 hours of day
daylight.note: core/bin/sun.ts at the station point for the first and last plan day: sunrise 06:40 to 06:42, sunset 18:32 to 18:28, day 11h52m to 11h45m.

notes.text: October nights average just above freezing, so pack a warm layer for evenings
